conclusion: H2 expands H1 from the 2x2 shifted determinants to the full Hankel structure.  All 4/4 sub-gates pass.  (a) The section 17 transform extends to Q_1..Q_9 and matches the zero + moment-tail expansion to 1.3e-07.  (b) At every sampled x > 0 the ladder D_0..D_3, the Hamburger Hankel [Q_{i+j+1}] and the Stieltjes Hankel [Q_{i+j+2}] are positive through order N = 3, computed without zero-location data.  (c) The shifted Schur/Vandermonde identity det[Q_{i+j+1}] = sum (prod q) prod (q_a-q_b)^2 holds to 5.8e-67.  (d) A strictly dominant synthetic off-axis pair drives the full shifted Hankel determinant negative for N = 1,2,3.  Nothing here proves RH: the Widder criterion is posited, positivity is sampled finitely, and the prime-gamma -> Hankel bridge is open.
experiment: widder/hankel level 2: full Hankel positivity ladder and shifted Schur/Vandermonde identities

gates.detail: One Taylor expansion of F_xi at each x supplies Q_1..Q_9 through the finite differential transform; the cross-check uses the direct zero sum for Q_3..Q_9 (fast convergence at 300 zeros) and the exact log-Xi moment series for Q_1, Q_2 (whose 1/gamma^2 and 1/gamma^4 tails are not negligible).  Worst relative residual: 1.26e-07.
gates.gate: H2a: section 17 transform extends to Q_1..Q_9 and matches the zero + moment-tail expansion

gates.detail: On the first 8 zeros (the identity is algebraic, so a small multiset is exact; C(8,4) triples are infeasible over all 300 zeros), the shifted Hankel determinant matches the Schur/Vandermonde sum for N = 1, 2, 3, and the D_m Vandermonde form matches for m = 0..3, to 5.78e-67.  Under RH each summand is >= 0.
gates.gate: H2d: shifted Schur/Vandermonde identity -- det[Q_{i+j+1}] equals sum_{i_0<...<i_N} (prod q) prod (q_a - q_b)^2

gates.detail: At x in [0.5, 1.0, 4.0], D_m = Q_{2m+1}Q_{2m+3}-Q_{2m+2}^2 > 0 for m = 0..3, and both the Hamburger Hankel [Q_{i+j+1}] and the Stieltjes Hankel [Q_{i+j+2}] have all leading principal determinants positive up to order N = 3.  These are the sampled Stieltjes-moment positivity conditions (framework sections 9, 16), computed from the explicit formula without zero-location data -- evidence consistent with RH, not a proof.
gates.gate: H2b/H2c: the shifted-det ladder D_0..D_3 and the full Hankel matrices are positive on the sampled half-line

gates.detail: Replacing the real transformed-zero scales by a strictly dominant conjugate pair q_* = e^{+-0.7 i} over four real background q_j materially breaks Stieltjes positivity: det[Q_{i+j+1}] < 0 for N = 1, 2, 3 (N=1: -1.923e+00, N=2: -3.304e-01, N=3: -4.289e-05).  This is the section 10 obstruction lifted from the 2x2 shifted determinant to the full Hankel matrix -- the derived off-axis mechanism, not an RH proof.
gates.gate: H2e: a strictly dominant off-axis pair drives the full shifted Hankel determinant negative
